page_title: VAL 1-1 BAR | Valencia v Barcelona 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' The ball goes behind for a corner. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona). Barcelona have a corner.

90+3' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Ronald Araujo (Barcelona), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
90+3' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
90+1' A player from Valencia commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Barcelona couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
89' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Barcelona have been awarded a free kick.

88' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias no option but to blow his whistle. Valencia will take a free kick.
87' Pedri (Barcelona) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
83' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.

83' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Raphinha (Barcelona), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
81' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) replacing Jesus Vazquez.
81' Here comes a substitution. Ilkay Gundogan is given a rest as he is replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
81' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Hugo Duro is replaced by Alberto Mari (Valencia).
81' Substitution. Diego Lopez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
79' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sees a yellow card from Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
78' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
77' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.

77' Hugo Duro (Valencia) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
76' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias saw the whole situation. Valencia have a free kick.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) for Joao Felix.
72' Substitution. Selim Amallah (Valencia) in, Fran Perez out.
71' 1 - 1 Goal! Great play by Diego Lopez releases Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top right corner. 1:1.
68' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

67' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
65' Fran Perez (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias had a clear view and blows his whistle.
62' Substitution. Roman Yaremchuk will be replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
61' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
60' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
59' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle after Joao Felix (Barcelona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Valencia earn a free kick.
58' Joao Felix (Barcelona) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Joao Felix (Barcelona) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.

56' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Inaki Pena pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

55' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Raphinha, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Joao Felix (Barcelona), who beats Giorgi Mamardashvili with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

52' What a big chance! Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
51' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) commits a foul during an attacking move.
51' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
50' A pass into the penalty area from Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) is intercepted by the defence.
50' The attendance is 46492.
48' None of the Valencia players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
48' Diego Lopez (Valencia) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Valencia earn a corner.
47' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Pepelu (Valencia) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Barcelona get a free kick.
45+2' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.

45+1' Joao Felix (Barcelona) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Giorgi Mamardashvili, who pulls off a comfortable save!
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' The free kick is taken by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona), but ball is cleared.
44' Diego Lopez (Valencia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul. Barcelona have a free kick.

43' Diego Lopez (Valencia) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
42' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) is able to continue to play.
40' The game is interrupted now, Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
39' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Hugo Duro (Valencia) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
37' A pass by Fran Perez (Valencia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

35' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.

34' Pedri (Barcelona) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
32' Dangerous play by Ronald Araujo (Barcelona). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Valencia.
32' Raphinha (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
31' A cross into the box from Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) is cleared.

28' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Giorgi Mamardashvili shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
27' A cross from Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
26' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Barcelona win a free kick.
25' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
23' A pass from Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.
22' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' Diego Lopez (Valencia) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
19' Joao Felix (Barcelona) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul. Valencia are awarded the free kick.

18' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
17' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
17' Diego Lopez (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but Inaki Pena punches the ball away. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Hugo Duro (Valencia) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

16' What a save from Inaki Pena! Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
15' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
15' Fran Perez (Valencia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. It will be a corner kick for Valencia.
15' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
13' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' Thierry Correia (Valencia) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
11' Poor challenge! Fran Perez (Valencia) is penalised for tripping and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. A free kick to Barcelona.
10' A lofted pass into the box is met by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
9' Joao Felix (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
6' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
5' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
5' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
4' Raphinha (Barcelona) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Barcelona will have a corner.
3' Diego Lopez (Valencia) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
2' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.

2' Inaki Pena pulls off a great save to deny Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.
